definitions.explanation: the sector of the economy that provides services rather than manufactured goods

examples.japanese: サービス{業|ぎょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: I work in the service industry.

examples.japanese: サービス{業|ぎょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{休日|きゅうじつ}→休日：03028_kyuujitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{不規則|ふきそく}→不規則：15651_fukisoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧がちだ。
examples.english: In the service industry, days off tend to be irregular.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧サービス{業|ぎょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{中心|ちゅうしん}→中心：01467_chuushin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧してきた。
examples.english: Japan's economy has grown centering on the service industry.

notes:
Composed of ⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧ (service) + {業|ぎょう} (industry, business). Covers a wide range of businesses including hospitality, retail, food service, healthcare, and entertainment.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- サービス{業|ぎょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{従事|じゅうじ}→従事：12562_juuji⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be engaged in the service industry
- サービス{業|ぎょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧: to work in the service industry
- サービス{業|ぎょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人手不足|ひとでぶそく}→人手不足：11436_hitodebusoku⟧: labor shortage in the service sector
- サービス{業|ぎょう}⟦{全般|ぜんぱん}→全般：04383_zenpan⟧: service industry as a whole

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{接客業|せっきゃくぎょう}→接客業：17432_sekkyakugyou⟧: customer-facing work — specifically jobs involving direct interaction with customers
- ⟦{製造業|せいぞうぎょう}→製造業：14148_seizougyou⟧: manufacturing industry — produces physical goods, in contrast to services
- {第三次産業|だいさんじさんぎょう}: tertiary industry — the economic classification that includes services

NOTE: In Japan, サービス{業|ぎょう} workers often work weekends and holidays since those are peak customer times. This is a common topic in discussions about work-life balance.
